      "band": "Unranked",

      "rationale": "The changes in test files adapt existing validation tests and fuzzers to snapshot changes rather than modifying shared test infrastructure."
    },

      "name": "tools",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds txoutsetsummary subcommand to bitcoin-util in src/bitcoin-util.cpp.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds a txoutsetsummary subcommand to bitcoin-util to compute snapshot statistics and hashes without importing data into a database. This gives node operators a standalone tool to inspect and verify snapshot files directly."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Introduces a generic BlockingQueue utility in src/util/blockingqueue.h and filesystem helpers in src/util/fs_helpers.*.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.3,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Introduces a reusable BlockingQueue primitive for multithreaded coordination. While designed to support the assumeutxo pipeline, it adds general concurrency infrastructure to the codebase."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Replaces assumeutxo snapshot loading pipeline across src/validation.cpp, src/node/utxo_snapshot.*, src/coins.*, and src/txdb.*.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "speedup",
      "rationale": "Significantly improves loadtxoutset performance by replacing sequential CCoinsViewCache staging with a multithreaded decoding, hashing, and writing pipeline directly to LevelDB. It removes redundant caching and intermediate fsync bottlenecks during assumeutxo onboarding and unblocks issue #35054."
